name: Circle of Inevitability
overview: Lord of Mysteries 2: Circle of Inevitability, by Cuttlefish That Loves Diving, is a dark fantasy web novel acting as the sequel to Lord of Mysteries. Set ~7 years after the first book, it follows Lumian Lee, a survivor of a village catastrophe seeking truth in Trier, dealing with corruption, and joining the Tarot Club as "Seven of Wands"
